name: Concert Night
question: How did that last song make you feel?
scene: an oil painting of an outdoor concert stage at night under colored lights, a sea of raised hands, haze in the beams, visible brushstrokes
closing: The whole crowd is painting this stage together. Your song is part of it now.
consent: The camera follows your fingertip and the mic hears your answer. We don't save video or sound.
Chrome sends your voice to Google to turn it into text, and Google's Gemini AI reads that text to pick your colors.
Your words aren't saved. We keep your path, your painting and a short mood label.
No name needed. The shared painting and mood labels are shown publicly.
